messages.subject: Kudos
parts: As a counter to all the bug reports I've filed (from using Stan on an unsupported platform), I just want to say that I'm really impressed at what the Stan team have accomplished. Once I got past the initial learning curve, I've gotten some very good results. I have a 55-line hierarchical multinomial logit model in Stan that is outperforming some custom code that had months of effort poured into it!
